description: A painting of a dim 19th-century room. A man in a dark frock coat and white cravat stands behind a seated, balding older man and presses both hands on his head. Plaster busts with painted grid lines sit on shelves on the left, one skull-like, lit by candles. Spectators in period dress sit in the background beneath anatomical prints. No legible text, no frame, no gore.
